I’m not connected to live financial feeds, so I can’t give you the exact rate at this very moment.  
As of the most recent data I’ve seen, the exchange rate has been hovering around **1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP**. Using that figure:

- 20 USD × 0.78 GBP/USD ≈ **15.6 GBP**

So roughly **£15–16** would be the equivalent of $20 today.  

If you need the precise, up‑to‑minute rate, you’ll want to check a reliable financial news source, your bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app.
